arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack originating from internal IP 10.0.5.14 targeted the domain controller (10.0.8.200) with massive failed Kerberos TGT requests, indicating attempted password spraying against service accounts. Concurrently, IDS detected Cobalt Strike beacon activity from the same source to an external C2 server (198.51.100.23). Lateral movement attempts via SMB and suspicious rundll32 execution were observed on workstation WS-FIN-042. Immediate containment actions revoked the compromised service account (svc_backup_admin), rotated all associated tokens, and blocked the malicious source IP. The incident was contained within hours, preventing further domain compromise.
